spots.name: Masjid al-Haram

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Masjid al-Haram, also known as the Great Mosque of Mecca, is a mosque in Mecca, Saudi Arabia, serving as the holiest and most important mosque in Islam. As of 2026, the Great Mosque is the largest mosque in the world.

spots.name: The Clock Towers

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Clock Towers, formerly known as Abraj al-Bait, is a government-owned hotel complex with seven skyscraper hotels in Mecca, Saudi Arabia. These towers are part of the King Abdulaziz Endowment Project that aims to modernize the city in catering to its pilgrims.

spots.name: Jannat al-Mu'alla
spots.summary: Jannat al-Mu'alla, also known as the "Cemetery of Ma'la" and Al-Ḥajūn, is a historic cemetery located to the north of Masjid al-Haram, and near the Mosque of the Jinn in Mecca, Saudi Arabia.

spots.name: Ajyad Fortress
spots.summary: The Ajyad Fortress was an 18th century Ottoman-era citadel which stood on a hill overlooking the Grand Mosque of Mecca, in what is now Saudi Arabia.

spots.name: Jamaraat Bridge
spots.summary: The Jamaraat Bridge is a pedestrian bridge in Mina, Saudi Arabia, near Makkah used by Muslims during the Hajj ritual Stoning of the Devil. The purpose of the bridge is to enable pilgrims to throw stones at the three jamrah pillars either from the ground level or from the bridge.

spots.name: Abu Qubays
spots.summary: Abu Qubays is a sacred mountain which resides on the eastern frontier of Al-Masjid Al-Haram in Mecca, in the Hejaz region of Saudi Arabia.

spots.name: Clock Tower Museum

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Clock Tower Museum is a museum occupying the top four floors of the Mecca Royal Clock Tower in Mecca, Saudi Arabia. The museum, located at the highest point in Makkah, is operated by the Misk Foundation, a non-profit organization established by Crown Prince Muhammad Bin Salman.

spots.name: Masjid at-Taneem

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Masjid at-Taneem is a historic mosque in the area of Al-Hil, approximately 8.0 kilometres from the Kaaba, in the neighbourhood of At-Tan'im in Mecca, Saudi Arabia.

spots.name: Baab-al-Salaam
spots.summary: Baab-As-Salaam (Arabic: باب السلام), pronounced as "bāb assalām", is one of the gates at the Great Mosque of Mecca in Saudi Arabia. This phrase in Arabic when literally translated into English means "Gate of Peace".

spots.name: Makkah Al Mukarramah Library

hours.note: Closed Sun; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Makkah Al Mukarramah Library is a library near the Masjid al-Haram in Mecca, Saudi Arabia. Since it is believed to stand on the spot where the Islamic prophet Muhammad was born, it was also previously known as the Bayt al-Mawlid.

spots.name: Bay'ah Mosque

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Bay'ah Mosque, also known as the Mosque of 'Aqaba Hill and the Aqabah Mosque, is a Sunni Muslim mosque, located outside Mecca in Saudi Arabia, below the Wadi Mina.

spots.name: Mina
spots.summary: Mina is a neighborhood of Mecca. It has the nick name of Tent City, as there are hundred of thousands of air-conditioned tents in the area, which act as temporary accommodations for pilgrims during Hajj time. The pedestrian-only Jamaraat Bridge, where the symbolic ritual of Stoning of the Devil is done, is located here.
